description: When Currys Black Friday 2026 deals start, how its price promise works, and the TV, laptop and kitchen prices worth waiting for.
intro:
**Currys says its Black Friday 2026 deals will start in early November, ahead of Black Friday itself on 27 November.** In 2025 its sale began at the very end of October and ran right through to Cyber Monday, so expect something similar this year.

For now, most big-name products at Currys are at full price, with no 'was' price showing. That's a clear sign to wait unless you need something urgently. We'll update this page when the deals go live. Last checked: 27 October 2026.

body:
## When does Currys Black Friday 2026 start?

Currys hasn't given an exact date. On 27 October its homepage said 'Black Friday is coming soon', and its Black Friday page says early deals 'launch early in November'. Its current Autumn Sale appears to end around 1 November, which fits a start in the first days of November.

Past years:

- **2025:** started on 29 or 30 October and ran to Cyber Monday (1 December). Most deals ended at midnight that night.
- **2024:** the sale was already live by 1 November, with over 2,000 products reduced.

The main event runs from Black Friday (27 November) to Cyber Monday (30 November). For other retailers' dates, see our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/).

## Currys's Black Friday price promise

Currys says that if an eligible item you buy early drops further on Black Friday, it will refund the difference. It hasn't published the 2026 terms yet. In 2025 you had to register your purchase by the end of November, and the cover ran until the start of December.

In 2025, Currys also said every Black Friday deal would be 'the lowest price it's ever been' at Currys, and it labelled items with an 'Our Lowest Ever Price' badge. That's a useful check, but it only refers to Currys's own prices, not other shops.

## Price matching

Currys's everyday Price Promise matches any other UK retailer's price, in store or online, including discount codes. You can claim before you buy or up to seven days after. It won't match marketplace sellers, membership or loyalty prices, or staff, student and NHS codes. So if Amazon or Argos is cheaper, ask Currys to match it.

## Currys Perks, trade-in and recycling

- **Currys Perks** is free to join with an email address. Members get exclusive prices and offers, and Currys is running a prize draw for a £500 gift card ahead of Black Friday.
- **Trade-in:** you can trade old tech for a gift card in store or a bank payment online, and put it towards something new.
- **Recycling:** Currys will recycle any old tech for free in its stores, even if you didn't buy it there.

## What was cheap at Currys last Black Friday

These 2025 Black Friday prices are a good guide to what to expect:

- Ninja Max 6-in-1 Dual Zone air fryer: £158 (was £229.99)
- De'Longhi Magnifica S bean-to-cup coffee machine: £299 (was £479.99)
- Dyson V15s Detect Submarine: £599 (was £799)
- Apple iPad 11in 128GB: £299 (was £329)
- Lenovo Yoga Slim 7 OLED laptop: £549 (was £849)
- Philips 5000 Series air fryer: £170

The best categories at Currys tend to be OLED TVs and soundbars, mid-range laptops and iPads, coffee machines, air fryers and cordless vacuums. For target prices by brand, see our guides to [TV Black Friday deals](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/), [air fryers](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Dyson](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## How to get the best Currys deal

1. **Check the price history.** A big 'save £X' isn't always a real saving. Use a price tracker or compare with our target prices.
2. **Use the price promise.** If you see the same product cheaper at another big retailer, ask Currys to match it.
3. **Don't wait too long on popular TVs.** The best-value OLED sizes can sell out over Black Friday weekend.

### When do Currys Black Friday deals start in 2026?

Currys says early deals will launch in early November. In 2025 the sale started at the end of October and ran until Cyber Monday.

### Does Currys price match on Black Friday?

Its Price Promise matches other UK retailers' prices, including discount codes, before you buy or up to seven days after. Marketplace sellers and membership prices are excluded.

### What is the Currys Black Friday price promise?

If an eligible item you buy early gets cheaper on Black Friday, Currys says it will refund the difference. Check the terms on the product page when the 2026 sale starts.

### Is it worth buying from Currys now or waiting?

Wait. On 27 October most big-brand products at Currys were at full price, and last year's Black Friday prices were much lower.
